name: crew-companion
description: A companion that lives on your desktop and shows you what your crew is up to. Every session that is working — or waiting on you — gets its own character, and the companion speaks up when one finishes, fails, or needs your OK. Click a character to open the crew view, where you can answer it. It also helps you pace your day, with break nudges, reminders in plain language, and a short breathing exercise.
author: kirocrew
highlights: A character on your desktop for every session that is working or waiting on you
Speaks up when a turn finishes, fails, or needs your approval — bad news is never silenced
Click a character to open the crew view and approve, reply, or take a closer look
Gentle break nudges, and reminders you set in plain language, like “drink water in 20 minutes”
A short breathing exercise, and a swappable avatar you can import or draw yourself
